notes: Asking Price and Gross Revenue are present on all pages via their labels in the noborder table. Adj. Cash Flow is labeled 'Adj. Cash Flow*:' but is empty on all three pages — the broker never publishes this value, so not_disclosed=true. City and state are not in separate fields; they appear together after the 'Location:' label inside the Executive Summary table (e.g. 'Peoria, Illinois Area' or 'Central Illinois'). Both city and state must be parsed from that single Location label value. Revenue shows '$1' as a placeholder on all pages, indicating the broker intentionally omits real revenue figures, but the field/label is structurally present.
